Behavioral specification:
1) DELETE vars loadNemotronBtn, unloadNemotronBtn, loadDeepseekBtn, unloadDeepseekBtn and their four addEventListener blocks.
2) ADD vars: ejectModelBtn, loadConfirmModal, loadConfirmBtn, loadCancelBtn, loadConfirmText, unloadConfirmModal, unloadConfirmBtn, unloadCancelBtn, unloadConfirmText — all via getElementById.
3) REWRITE fetchModels(): fetch BOTH /api/v1/models and /api/v1/models/catalog (Promise.all). Options = lmstudio entries from /api/v1/models plus ALL catalog entries. Label: (loaded ? '🟢 ' : '○ ') + id; prefix '✓ ' when id === modelSelect.value. Set data-loaded='true'/'false'. If catalog fetch fails, fall back to lmstudio only.

5) ejectModelBtn: reveal on modelSelect focus, hide on blur (200ms timeout). Click: find loaded script model, show unload-confirm-modal. unload-confirm POSTs /api/v1/script-models/{id}/unload, refreshes.

Implementation constraints: synchronous Python, stdlib + httpx. Modify src/services/models.py to implement AC-102..AC-106.

Behavioral specification:
1) In load_script_model: change the error message when the child process exits before readiness from a timeout message to a distinct message (e.g. 'child exited').
2) In load_script_model: on deadline timeout, ensure the spawned server is terminated (unreachable), not just left running.
3) In _unload_other_script_models (or equivalent): before spawning, ensure the other model is unreachable. If it cannot be evicted, abort the load with an error naming the model.
4) In unload_script_model: implement AC-102 — discover the server by port or command basename if no handle is tracked, and terminate it. If termination fails (server stays reachable), return {'status': 'error', 'message': ...} per AC-103.
5) Keep list_model_catalog function.

Acceptance: grep -q 'def list_model_catalog' src/services/models.py && grep -q 'SCRIPT_MODELS' src/services/models.py
